name: Unbroken attack power does not outlive a relog frozen (#11503)
contract: #11503: Unbroken 707407 'This degrades slowly over time, and while out of combat'. The attack power aura 707487 is granted by hits the hunter takes and decays on a two second tick. A character that logs out holding the buff must not log back in with an attack power aura that nothing decays.
Expected independent of the implementation: after a relog with no further damage, the buff is gone (or has decayed) once six idle seconds have passed.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Taking hits grants the attack power aura
SETUP: the buff is held when the character logs out
CONTROL: the passive talent is back after the relog
No attack power aura is left frozen after the idle wait
